title: (PDF) Epigallocatechin-3-gallate (EGCG) for Clinical Trials: More Pitfalls than Promises?
abstract: August 31, 2011 - The mechanism by which absorption was enhanced was not through an effect of CS NPs on intestinal paracellular or passive transcellular transport processes (as shown by transport of (14)C-mannitol and (3)H-propranolol) or an effect on efflux proteins (as shown by transport of (3)H-digoxin) but was likely due to stabilization of catechins after encapsulation (99.7+/-0.7 vs 94.9+/-3.8% and 56.9+/-3.0 vs 1.3+/-1.7% of the initial C and EGCg concentration remaining, respectively). This study demonstrates that encapsulation of catechins in CS NPs enhances their intestinal absorption and is a promising strategy for improving their bioavailability.
